Note: Infosys recent investments as part of Infosys Innovation Fund:
1. Aerchain (https://aerchain.io/), AI-driven sourcing & procurement startup. Enterprises are unlocking AI value to build smarter sourcing & procurement function. Infosys is at the forefront, bringing AI-powered deeptech solutions to forward-thinking organizations across industries to create a more resilient, informed, and strategic capabilities that gives global corporations an edge in the market. Infosys Innovation Funds investment in Aerchain brings the power of Infosys ecosystem to co-create next-gen solutions making sourcing seamless, data-driven, and future ready. Infosys will transform organizations to accelerate AI-powered value creation and redefine procurement excellence, together with Aerchain. *Agreements were signed in the preceding quarter (25-03-2026); and the corresponding shares were received during the current quarter.
2. 4baseCare (www.4basecare.com), AI powered precision oncology startup. Personalized treatment based on advanced genomic and comprehensive clinical information can enhance cancer-outcomes significantly. The population specific datasets powered by tech-driven AI and Analytics solutions has immense potential to improve cancer diagnosis, treatment, drug discovery and development across Healthcare and Life Sciences ecosystem. 4baseCare develops cutting-edge precision oncology solutions, using advanced genomics and next-gen digital health technology, to personalize patient care in oncology. 4baseCare has developed a unique set of comprehensive genomic panels which allows oncologists to choose the optimal targeted therapy for their patients. 4baseCare is focused on advanced analytics and AI to enhance data-driven treatment recommendations, while expanding the presence across Asia and the Middle East. Infosys Innovation Funds follow-on investment (invested initially in Dec 2024) further strengthens co-creation of next-generation solutions bringing the power of innovation to help Infosys clients across Healthcare and Life Sciences industry.
3. Team8 (https://team8.vc), a global VC firm investing in startups across AI, Cyber Security, Software, Fintech and Digital Health. Infosys commits to invest as a Limited Partner in Team8 as part of Infosys Innovation Fund. Team8 is an early-stage VC fund focused on AI, Cyber Security, Software, Fintech and Digital Health. Backed by a team of serial entrepreneurs, industry leaders and domain experts building a strong system from incubation to investments, Team8 brings corporate partners and startups together to solve most pressing problems with structured partnership programs. Infosys Innovation Fund to partner with Team8s ecosystem and startups to complement Infosys capabilities, and jointly co-create next-generation solutions bringing the power of AI, Cyber Security to help Infosys clients navigate their business transformation.
4. Indivi (https://indivi.io), Switzerland based TechBio startup for neuroscience drug development. Neuroscience has an R&D constraint as the probability of technical and regulatory success is exceptionally low. The ability to measure impact of treatment in a slow progressing and heterogeneous neuroscience disease makes effect detection of the treatment extremely challenging. At the same time, a global epidemic of age-related neuroscience diseases is on a significant rise globally, resulting in pressure on the healthcare systems. Life Sciences companies are investing billions in R&D and clinical trials. The convergence of technological progress (sensor, radiomics, AI/ML, compute, quantum, sequencing) and data creates an opportunity to transform medicine development (patient-centric self-measurement, deep phenotyping of disease, tech-derived biomarkers/endpoints, AI-based companion diagnostics and predictive maintenance, reverse translational discovery). Indivi is a digital bio-marker platform specialist enhancing the success rate drug development in neuroscience. Infosys Innovation Funds investment in Indivi brings the power of Infosys ecosystem to co-create next-gen solutions to unlock value for clients across Healthcare and Life Sciences industry.
5 NinjaTech AI (www.ninjatech.ai), US based personal Agentic AI startup. AI has potential to unlock significant opportunities for enterprises. However, evolving AI capabilities and enterprise needs require effective execution. NinjaTechs personal agentic AI is autonomous, self-evolving, and interacts with other agentic AI and humans. Infosys Innovation Funds investment brings the power of client and business context in amplifying the Human + AI model in AI execution to unlock business value. #Investment is in Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE), ownership % will be determined post conversion.
6 GalaxEye (https://galaxeye.space), SpaceTech startup. SpaceTech is a frontier technology with potential to unlock significant value to businesses globally and create high impact solutions at scale. GalaxEye, builds multi-sensor (Synthetic Aperture Radar + Multi Spectral Imaging) satellites and synchronization platform generating comprehensive all-weather, high-resolution and intuitive datasets. Infosys Innovation Funds follow-on investment (invested initially in 2024) in GalaxEye further strengthens co-creation of next-generation solutions bringing the power of AI and SpaceTech innovation to help clients navigate their business transformation.
